## Part 2 — Configuration Architecture

| Dimension | What it controls | Levels | Dependencies |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Depth** | How much human expertise wraps the skill | Skill-only / Skill + async review / Skill + live co-production | Live co-production requires Priority or Dedicated access |
| **Breadth** | How many vertical packs + reference extensions included | Core only / Core + 1 pack / Core + all packs | All-packs requires paid tier |
| **Pace** | Cadence of updates + skill evolution | Community-release / Monthly briefing / Weekly iteration loop | Weekly requires self-iteration GHA enabled |
| **Format** | How the skill is delivered + maintained | Public repo / Private fork / White-labeled distribution | White-label requires top tier |
| **Support** | Response channel + SLA | Community / Email 48h / Slack same-day / Dedicated consultant | Dedicated requires top tier |
| **Memory Scope** *(domain-specific)* | What persistent memory the skill can draw on | None / Local claude-mem / Shared benchmark DB / Private tenant DB | Shared/Private DBs are paid; Private requires top tier |
| **Configurator Export** *(domain-specific)* | Can blueprints emit directly to a builder tool | Off / JSON+YAML / Live Typeform/Webflow push | Live push requires paid tier |
| **Audit Rights** *(domain-specific)* | Human review of blueprints the skill produces | None / 1 per quarter / Unlimited / Live co-production | Live requires top tier |

**Invalid combinations the configurator must block:**
- White-label + Community-only support (brand liability without SLA)
- Weekly iteration loop + no memory backend (nothing to iterate against)
- Live configurator push + no vertical pack (nothing meaningful to push)
- Dedicated consultant + Skill-only depth (buying access with nothing to review)
- Private tenant memory DB + Public repo format (data leakage risk)

### Build-Your-Own Framework

**Base price:** Free (Lite). BYO adds paid dimensions à la carte on top of the free core.

**Per-dimension upgrade pricing (tokens):**
- +1 vertical pack: `+$P/mo`
- All vertical packs: `+$P×3/mo` (sum-of-parts, no discount)
- Monthly briefing: `+$M/mo`
- Weekly iteration loop: `+$W/mo` (requires memory backend)
- Email 48h support: `+$E/mo`
- Slack same-day: `+$S/mo`
- Dedicated consultant: `+$D/mo`
- Shared benchmark DB: `+$DB1/mo`
- Private tenant DB: `+$DB2/mo`
- JSON/YAML export: `+$X1/mo`
- Live configurator push: `+$X2/mo`
- Blueprint audit (per quarter): `+$Q` each
- Live co-production session: `+$L` each
- White-label rights: `+$WL/mo` (requires Slack same-day minimum)

**Floor:** Free (Lite is always available; no minimum spend to enter).

**Ceiling:** If BYO configuration sums above ~80% of Premium's price, auto-route to Premium (better value, no decision fatigue).

**Configurator dependencies to enforce:**
- White-label → must include Slack same-day or Dedicated
- Weekly iteration → must include a memory backend (shared or private)
- Live configurator push → must include at least 1 vertical pack
- Private tenant DB → cannot combine with public repo format (must take private fork or white-label)
- Dedicated consultant → must include at least Skill + async review depth

**Flagship-protection rule:**
- Core bundles: 1 vertical pack + monthly briefing + email support + shared DB + JSON/YAML export + 1 audit/quarter. BYO-summed equivalent (`$P + $M + $E + $DB1 + $X1 + $Q/3`) must exceed Core's `$A/mo`. If it doesn't, raise à la carte prices — never lower Core.
- Premium bundles: all packs + white-label + weekly loop + Slack + private DB + live push + unlimited audits + monthly co-pro. BYO-summed equivalent must exceed Premium's `$B/mo` by a visible margin (target: 1.4–1.6×). This is the discount that makes Premium the obvious choice for anyone configuring 4+ dimensions.
